description: A draft invoice extracted from a free-text billing request. Use an empty string for anything the request doesn't state.

customerName.description: Name of the customer being billed, exactly as written; empty if not stated.

issueDate.description: Invoice date as YYYY-MM-DD; empty if not stated.

dueDate.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD; resolve relative terms like '30 hari' from the issue date or today; empty if not stated.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code in upper case (e.g. IDR, USD); empty if not stated.

notes.description: Other billing remarks worth keeping on the invoice (payment terms, PO number); empty if none.

quantity.description: Plain decimal with a dot, e.g. 2 or 1.5.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit as a plain decimal with a dot and no thousands separators, e.g. 1500000.

discountPercent.description: Discount in percent, e.g. 10; 0 if none.

taxRatePercent.description: Tax rate in percent, e.g. 11 for PPN 11%; 0 if none.
